referenceFunction.generalComment: The process “light fuel oil, burned in industrial furnace 1MW, non-modulating/MJ/CH” includes the direct air emissions from combustion, including infrastructure, fuel consumption, waste and auxiliary electricity use. The inventory is based on the operation of an oil boiler, data related to fuel input and 5'000 operating hours. UUID: 848219fb-1486-42b3-b31e-6dec9ffc3b46
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset is based on the process “light fuel oil, burned in industrial furnace 1MW, non-modulating/MJ/CH”. Compared to this reference process, the dataset does not include air emissions of fossil carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, and particulates < 2.5 µm from the combustion of 1 MJ of light fuel oil, as these emissions are considered separately within the asphalt production processes.
referenceFunction.localName: Light fuel oil, burned in industrial furnace, for asphalt production, 1MW, non-modulating
referenceFunction.name: Light fuel oil, burned in industrial furnace, for asphalt production, 1MW, non-modulating

technology.text: The process "light fuel oil, burned in industrial furnace 1MW, non-modulating/MJ/CH" has been modified to generate a dataset that does not consider air emissions of fossil carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides, and particulates < 2.5 µm from the combustion of 1 MJ of light fuel oil in Switzerland.

timePeriod.text: Review of data currency scheduled after 5 years.
